glosses: real estate (typically rural and surrounding land but also urban)

examples.text: Él no tuvo dinero para comprar la finca.
examples.en: He had no money to buy the farm.

examples.text: Tiene varios compradores para la finca.
examples.en: He has several buyers for the property.

examples.text: El avión aterrizó en la finca de mi padre.
examples.en: The plane landed on my dad's farm.
